questions.q: Roughly what overall (fuel-to-electricity) efficiency does a diesel genset reach?
why: No — that is far too low for a modern diesel.
Correct! High compression gives ~35–45% overall fuel-to-shaft efficiency.
No — no heat engine reaches that; that figure ignores thermodynamic limits.

questions.q: To PARALLEL two AC generators safely, you must match voltage, frequency and:
why: No — colour is irrelevant to synchronization.
Correct! Voltage, frequency AND phase must match before closing the breaker.
No — fuel brand has nothing to do with electrical sync.

questions.q: In a generator's lifetime cost (LCOE), which term usually DOMINATES?
why: No — capex is real but fuel typically outweighs it over the life.
Correct! Recurring fuel cost usually dominates a genset's LCOE.
No — that is a negligible cost.
